   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 11.07.2026 - 11.07.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _A Sprz_, 11.07.2026, 3/5: "The app is beautiful. Love the customization. I got a lifetime subscription and am happy to not have to pay annually. Could you please consider adding the ability to increase the font size? It would be perfect then."

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 04.08.2026 - 29.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Anissa Garcia_, 29.08.2026, 1/5: "I love this app. I believe there is a bug. I am unable to share habits with others and consistently get “Failed to modify some records” every time. The person I am trying to share habits with also gets the same notification. Please fix! 🫶🏼"
            2. _sianadele_, 17.08.2026, 1/5: "Downloaded this because I’ve seen so many people talking about it. It started off well but not every time I open the app it freezes and I can’t click anything!"
            3. _Girly1224_, 04.08.2026, 5/5: "Same issue here app keeps crashing and I have the paid version would really like it if I am updated about this current issue. I actually really like the app but this issue needs to be updated. Ill come back and give it a better review once its fixed."
<!--/ir-theme-->
